import os
os.makedirs(os.path.dirname(p),exist_ok=True)
code='''from collections import Counter
def transform(grid):
    h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0])
    out=[]
    for r in range(0,h,3):
        row=[]
        for c in range(0,w,3):
            vals=[grid[i][j] for i in range(r,min(r+3,h)) for j in range(c,min(c+3,w)) if grid[i][j] != 5]
            counts=Counter(vals)
            row.append(counts.most_common(1)[0][0] if counts else 5)
        out.append(row)
    return out
'''
open(p,'w').write(code)
exec(code)
